danger_formalization.robot_task: Cook peas by heating them in a saucepan with butter on a stove.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot spills hot water or melted butter while transferring it, creating a slippery surface.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Human slips and falls, potentially causing injury.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Pour water or melted butter from a container into the saucepan inaccurately.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Move slowly and precisely when pouring liquids, ensure proper grip and alignment over the saucepan to minimize spills.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic manipulation capabilities to handle containers and pour liquids, but may lack fine motor control for precise actions.
